Slop Docs · free, in your browser

A free Microsoft Word alternative in your browser

For letters, essays and simple reports, Slop Docs gives you a page, styles and Word files in a browser tab, with no installation, no account and nothing uploaded.

Open Slop Docs

How to do it

  1. Open Slop Docs and start typing, or import a .docx you keep in Slop Drive.
  2. Format with fonts, sizes, paragraph styles, alignment and lists.
  3. Save to Slop Drive in this browser; drafts are saved as you type.
  4. Download Word (.docx), Markdown or plain text, or print.

Your files stay on this device: Slop Docs runs in your browser, with no upload, no account and no watermark.

Questions

Is Slop Docs made by Microsoft?

No. Slopographic is not affiliated with Microsoft. Microsoft and Word are trademarks of their owner, named here only to describe what people search for.

Can it open my Word files?

Yes, from Slop Drive. Paragraphs, text formatting, styles, lists, tables and page setup are read. Pictures, headers, footers, footnotes, comments and tracked changes are not carried over yet.

Does it work offline?

Once the page has loaded, documents are edited and saved in the browser, so a lost connection does not stop you.

Is it really free?

Yes. There is no plan to buy and no account. Your documents stay on your device.
